objective: A deployed, governed first working vertical, not a demo or a promise of income.
delivery_policy: Use the full blueprint and later human corrections. Work through concrete acceptance checks; report unverified integrations honestly.

tasks.acceptance: Additive schemas, explicit projection, bounded authenticated data read/write path and verified loaded records.
Durable versioned objects, tasks, proposals, decisions and concurrency control; Firebase identity with scoped roles.
Definitions, synonyms, rules, source-linked assertions, recorded-as-of queries and reviewed ontology proposals.
Governor, custodian, validator, population and discovery roles execute typed tasks with context, budgets and permissions.
Sanitized feedback changes a scoped retrieved policy, passes evaluations and invalidates affected outputs; unsafe promotion is rejected.
Maintainable catalogue, governed acquisition, generated review forms, comparisons, evidence and confidence explanations.
Distinct workflow families reuse visual primitives and authorised colourful imagery with background music, not mechanical narration.
Final MP4 plus metadata/thumbnail hashes, source and rights gates, structured review reasons and stale-approval invalidation.
Supported first-channel adapter or explicit manual fallback, post IDs, metrics and honest online revenue-path experiments.
Working cloud backend and Firebase frontend, CI, bounded jobs, observability, costs, security and end-to-end acceptance evidence.

exceptions: Secrets remain local unless a specific production credential-storage boundary is resolved.
No rights, factual, publication or financial approval is inferred from autonomy.
Later human creative and online-business corrections supersede contradictory earlier defaults.
Media quality and factual quality are distinct gates; neither is replaced by test counts.
